english.notes:
(i) Packaging has the same meaning as in regulation 3 of the Packaging (Essential Requirements) Regulations 2015 (regulation 3(5)).
(ii) It is a defence for a person to show that P took all reasonable steps and exercised all due diligence to avoid committing the offence (see regulation 6 for full details).
(iii) Where a fixed monetary penalty or compliance notice has been served on any person or, a third-party undertaking is accepted from a person as part of the civil scheme under Schedule 1 then, it is generally not possible to proceed with criminal proceedings, see paragraph 8 of Schedule 1.

Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex - an information may be tried if it is laid within twelve months after the date on which evidence sufficient in the opinion of the prosecutor to justify the proceedings comes to the knowledge of the prosecutor. No proceedings are to be brought more than three years after the commission of the offence.
